age.evidence: Experiments were performed in 12-week-old female Sprague-Dawley rats

sex.evidence: 12-week-old female Sprague-Dawley rats; saline (n=4), psilocybin 5 mg/kg (n=6), psilocybin 20 mg/kg (n=6), S-ketamine 100 mg/kg (n=4), MK-801 1 mg/kg (n=4)

dosing.evidence: Animals were treated intraperitoneally with: (1) vehicle (0.9% NaCl, 10 ml/kg), (2) S-ketamine 100 mg/kg, (3) psilocybin 5 mg/kg, (4) psilocybin 20 mg/kg

judge_notes: No behavioural assays were conducted in this study. The paper exclusively performs immunohistochemical whole-brain mapping for HSP70 expression after psilocybin/ketamine/MK-801 administration. Per rubric, histological/anatomical endpoints (HSP70 staining, cell counting) are explicitly excluded from scoring.
All three candidates correctly returned an empty assays array.
